ara_s.t: Here we go. Hold the pose, and breathe slowly.

ara_r.t: Here we go. Move with your breath.

primer_r.t: First side. Move with your breath.

descans.t: Well done. Let go, and rest for a few seconds.

respira_1.t: Breathe in through your nose... and as you exhale, sink a little deeper into the pose.

respira_2.t: Soften your shoulders and your jaw. Breathe.

respira_3.t: With every exhale, let the tension melt away.

final.t: That's the end of your practice. Stay here a moment, eyes closed, and breathe. Well done.
